summary.text: Sue Rieke Smith is a Democratic state representative from District 26 who has held the seat since June 2025 and is seeking election on November 3, 2026.
She was appointed to the seat on June 6, 2025, replacing Courtney Neron, and appears on the November 3, 2026 ballot with Democratic and Independent Party of Oregon nominations.

paragraphs.text: Sue Rieke Smith earned a bachelor's degree from Pacific Lutheran University and a graduate degree from the University of Oregon.
Her career experience includes work in education and nursing.
